text: Monad is a high-performance, Ethereum-compatible Layer 1.
Ten thousand transactions per second. Three-hundred millisecond blocks. Six-hundred millisecond finality.
Transactions execute in parallel, while results commit in their original order.
Keep Solidity, Ethereum wallets, RPCs, and the tools you already know.
Monad improves performance through software architecture while preserving decentralization.
Build beyond limits. Build on Monad.
